# Radhvan Origins

> An educational study of Cordyceps militaris: its biology, key compounds (cordycepin, adenosine), evidence-based research, and lab cultivation.

Radhvan Origins is a cultivation and education studio. We grow Cordyceps militaris in a controlled lab and explain the science plainly — without overclaiming.

## Pages

- [/](/): The Cordyceps Study — home page with a cinematic overview of the fungus, its compounds, research highlights and future range.
- [/cordyceps-vs-sinensis](/cordyceps-vs-sinensis): Cordyceps militaris vs Cordyceps sinensis — explains the difference between wild and cultivated species.
- [/cordycepin](/cordycepin): Cordycepin explained — the nucleoside behind most Cordyceps research and how it is measured as a quality marker.
- [/cordyceps-health-benefits](/cordyceps-health-benefits): Evidence-based health benefits — cancer cell studies, mood, blood pressure, skin and joint research directions.
- [/cordyceps-cultivation](/cordyceps-cultivation): How Cordyceps militaris is cultivated in a controlled lab environment.
- [/cordyceps-faq](/cordyceps-faq): Frequently asked questions about Cordyceps, cordycepin, safety, sourcing and product availability.
